check: random-subsample reproducibility vs full M=2 run
closes_caveat: the pilot artifact DO_NOT_COMPARE caution about non-random pair selection

falsifiers.caveat: the full run traversed pairs lexicographically while services differ in flow count ~500x, which is why the concern was live in the first place
falsifiers.claim: the M=2 990/990 lower-gate result is not an artefact of pair ORDER
falsifiers.falsifier: re-run a RANDOM subsample of M=2 pairs and compare per-pair against the full run
falsifiers.result: 60-pair random subsample (seed 99): max abs diff 0.0 vs the same pairs in the full run, 60/60 clear the gate. Claim HOLDS.

interpretation: A RANDOM 60-pair subsample (seed 99) of the M=2 pairs reproduces the full-run values EXACTLY - max_abs_diff 0.0 against the same pairs in t1_lower_side_M2.json - and clears the 0.05 gate on 60/60 of them, as the full run does on 990/990. So the 990/990 lower-gate result is NOT an artefact of pair ORDER: the full run processed itertools.combinations lexicographically (all pairs of service 0 first), and services differ widely in flow count, so an order-correlated artefact was a live concern for the pilot I had flagged as non-random. It is now closed. Note the subsample median (0.8652) differs from the full-run median (0.8535) only because it is a different pair SET, not because of any order effect - the per-pair values are identical.
